messages:
zoe: Heads up - after the new egress ACL in eu-central, several GPU nodes are failing KMS/keystore access during boot.
ravi: seeing `403` from keystore proxy, mounts failing, warm-pool down ~30%.
security-bot: Change: egress-acl/v7 applied to vpc-prod-llm. Default deny; allowlist -> {10.0.0.0/16, 52.120.0.0/14}.
zoe: that misses keystore (10.77.10.0/24) and KMS proxy. Quick fix: append those CIDRs to the allowlist.
ops-bot: CR#5501 opened by ravi. Rollout immediate, rollback = restore previous ACL.
security-bot: Update applied: added 10.77.10.0/24,10.77.11.0/24. Change id egress-5501.
ravi: smoke test from node -> `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://keystore.internal/v1/ping` -> 200.
zoe: warm-pool recovering, provisioning errors dropping. Postmortem: add egress-service-registry and preflight check for changes touching ACLs.
ops-bot: Ticket ENG-INF-5502 created; owner zoe.
